episodes.title: Un petit détour
episodes.summary: Runaway single mother Alba starts working on a flower farm, only to be named the prime suspect in an investigation when a murder occurs on the property.

episodes.title: Quelqu'un savait
episodes.summary: After an attack, the police probe further into Alba's past. Lucie discovers an incriminating weapon in the house. Béatrice pays Léo a visit.

episodes.title: Rien ne va plus
episodes.summary: Béatrice tries to strike a deal with Alba as she and Valentin discover a disturbing hideout. An anonymous call tips police off about a suspect.

episodes.title: Comme les hyènes
episodes.summary: Mathieu works out a new deal for the farm and hosts a party, which Alba attends in a frantic search for Léo under the watchful eye of a hidden stalker.

episodes.title: Parle-moi
episodes.summary: Béatrice resists settling into her new accommodation. A shocking tragedy forces Alba to confess a secret to Léo and lean on Manon for support.

episodes.title: Une bonne mère
episodes.summary: Alba confronts Mathieu about his lies, learning the truth about her connection to the rose farm — and who has been targeting the Lasserre family.
